summary: Tested WC Table and WC Override features. Backend: 12/12 tests passed (100%). Frontend: WC table displays correctly with all required columns, Edit Initial WC works, first month WC override works, SalesGridEditor shows Opening Bal/Deposited/Cash Rcpt columns.
critical_code_review_comments: VERIFIED: POST /api/center-accounts/wc-table returns month-by-month WC data
VERIFIED: P/L formula is correct: P/L = Sale - Expenses (simple subtraction)
VERIFIED: Closing WC formula: closing_wc = opening_wc + pnl
VERIFIED: Diff from initial formula: diff_from_initial = closing_wc - initial_wc
VERIFIED: WC chaining works: opening WC of month N = closing WC of month N-1
VERIFIED: POST /api/center-accounts/wc-override sets initial WC (no month param)
VERIFIED: POST /api/center-accounts/wc-override sets month-specific opening WC override
VERIFIED: WC table UI shows all required columns: MONTH, SALE, EXPENSES, P/L, WORKING CAPITAL, BAL. WC., DIFF.OF WC.
VERIFIED: Edit Initial WC button works and shows success toast
VERIFIED: First month pencil icon allows editing opening WC override
VERIFIED: SalesGridEditor has Opening Bal column (editable for 1st day only per code)
VERIFIED: SalesGridEditor has Deposited and Cash Rcpt columns
